name: Collection Sections
description: Adds ability to add home screen sections for collections and playlists to Jellyfin. Requires the Home Screen Sections plugin.
overview: Add sections to the home screen for collections or playlists.

versions.changelog: Add Jellyfin 12 compatibility (targets 12.1.0 / net10.0). Requires Home Screen Sections v3.0.2.0 or later.
